visualCharacteristics.structure: image + title + release date + discount + rating + platforms + buy price; click a row to expand its full-width description
visualCharacteristics.layout: full-width rows with vertical dividers; each game row toggles a collapsed full-width details row (description); search/sort + load more generated by JS

contentPattern:
Table: header row (Image | Game | Discount | Rating | Platforms | Price | Description); one row per game: thumbnail image | title + 'Release date: ...' | '-' | '3 stars' | 'Windows, Steam, English' | 'BUY: $39.99' | description paragraphs (multiple

). Description is not rendered as a column: it becomes a collapsible details row toggled by clicking the game row / title button.
